Vendored from https://github.com/GPF/dreamcast-fmv
commit 9c0889ae9dc8d338a38341a72a260df6c870c4ec (2026-05-10), with local changes:
pack_dcmv.c / pack_dcmv_chunk.c accept COMPRESSION_BACKEND=lz40 (type 2, Dreamcast
LZ40 SH-4; see src/platform/dreamcast/dcfmv/lz40.h and lz40enc.h in this directory).

Only what tools/dc/build_disc.py runs: convert_to_pvr_fmv.sh, generate_durations.py, the packer sources
(pack_dcmv / pack_dcmv_chunk are compiled here on first use: gcc, liblz4, libzstd) and dcaconv, a prebuilt
x86-64 Linux binary of https://github.com/TapamN/dcaconv. The DCMV player itself lives in
src/platform/dreamcast/dcfmv. pvrtex comes from KallistiOS (utils/pvrtex).
